# Kautusang Bayan No. 03, Series of 1999

**Additional Appropriation Ordinance**

## Summary

This ordinance approves the additional appropriation from the 1999 Local Government Service Equalization Fund amounting to P284,116.00 for the additional primary needs and other expenses of the devolved offices of the local government of Pitogo, Quezon. It was enacted during the regular session of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] on November 29, [[1999]].

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1** - Allocates P284,116.00 from the 1999 Local Government Service Equalization Fund for the additional primary needs and expenses of the devolved offices of the local government of Pitogo, Quezon.
2.  **Section 2** - Incorporates the Additional Appropriation No. 03, Series of [[1999]], prepared by the Honorable Mayor, as "Annex A" to the ordinance.
3.  **Section 3** - States that the ordinance shall take effect upon its approval.
4.  **Section 4** - Ratifies the ordinance on November 29, [[1999]], in Pitogo, Quezon.
